comment: Echoes: a recogniser that does not catch the sound may give back the hint itself; a phrase of three or more parts, all of them items of the hint, is an echo and is dropped. What the recogniser is told before it listens (D-313): the folder of the session, its branch, the names of files from the conversation, then the keys of Aiko's memory when the memory is on. A path gives only its last part. The same name twice goes once, whatever its case. The hint stops before the item that would make it longer than the limit. The language is the language of the interface; System follows the system, and anything but Russian is English (D-314).
